dialect.detail: GnuCOBOL free-format source with $set sourceformat"free" directive; uses FUNCTION RANDOM and FUNCTION CURRENT-DATE which are COBOL-85/2002 intrinsic functions; Portuguese-language comments and identifiers suggest Brazilian GnuCOBOL usage

purpose.domain_detail: Lottery simulation (Loteria) challenge/exercise - simulates a lottery draw and checks user-picked numbers against randomly generated ones
purpose.summary: This program simulates a lottery game where the user enters 10 numbers (1-60), then the program randomly draws 6 numbers using a time-seeded random function. It repeatedly draws until all 6 drawn numbers match numbers in the user's selection, counting attempts and measuring elapsed time.

notable_features: FUNCTION CURRENT-DATE for elapsed time calculation
ACCEPT FROM TIME for seeding randomness
Deeply nested IF statements for number comparison
PERFORM UNTIL loop for repeated lottery draws
No COMP-3, no SQL, no CICS
verdict.notes: File uses latin-1 encoding with Portuguese accented characters in comments (e.g. randômica, sorteio). The $set directive overrides the mechanical fixed-format guess; source is genuinely free-format. The time-difference calculation in temp-sorteando appears to have the subtraction operands reversed (start minus end instead of end minus start), suggesting a student-level exercise. Program-id contains a dot which is unusual.
